page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 16 vCPUs and 128.0 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this instance allocates 16 physical cores with a single thread per core, ensuring dedicated CPU resources. The system operates on the KVM hypervisor and features a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps. The absence of integrated GPUs or local NVMe drives positions this instance specifically for workloads that rely heavily on memory capacity rather than local disk I/O or parallelized hardware acceleration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r6.4xlarge offers a dense memory configuration relative to its compute resources, making it a viable option for hosting in-memory databases, caching layers, and enterprise applications. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable performance for workloads such as SAP HANA, Redis, Memcached, and medium-sized relational database management systems.
